_README: Official NSE closes for index sessions our feeds lack or carry wrong (runbook §214a F6). Applied by scripts/fetch_fii_dii.apply_index_fix() at the end of update_nifty() and update_yahoo_index(), AFTER each merge — nifty500/nifty_bank are re-read whole from Yahoo every run and Yahoo's value would otherwise overwrite a corrected date.

Entry {file, date, close, was, why}: lands when the date is absent or holds `was` (the value measured wrong); a date holding anything else is left alone and reported. Each close = NSE's ind_close_all file for the day, confirmed by the next session's file (its previous close) and our stored previous close (close - points change), and by niftyindices.com.

2026-09-28 (user "yes"): 85 missing sessions (NIFTY 50 33, NIFTY 500 29, NIFTY BANK 23) + NIFTY BANK 2018-11-07 Muhurat 25,769.70 -> 25,737.50. Left out: 2012-01-02 NIFTY 50 and 2012-01-07 (all three) — NSE has no daily file for them and Yahoo lacks them; niftyindices alone is one source.
